data.text:
"Create translate_text.py in the current working directory.
Task: translates a single text string between languages.
Use one concrete external provider and make that provider identifiable in code.
"

input.patchText:
*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: translate_text.py
+import os
+import sys
+from openai import OpenAI
+
+
+def translate_text(text: str, source_language: str, target_language: str) -> str:
+    client = OpenAI(api_key=os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY"))
+    response = client.responses.create(
+        model="gpt-5.4-mini",
+        input=[
+            {
+                "role": "system",
+                "content": (
+                    f"Translate the user's text from {source_language} to {target_language}. "
+                    "Return only the translated text."
+                ),
+            },
+            {"role": "user", "content": text},
+        ],
+    )
+    return response.output_text
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    if len(sys.argv) < 4:
+        raise SystemExit("Usage: translate_text.py <source_language> <target_language> <text>")
+    source_language = sys.argv[1]
+    target_language = sys.argv[2]
+    text = " ".join(sys.argv[3:])
+    print(translate_text(text, source_language, target_language))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
*** End Patch
